Claude Code Limit Maximizer

TokenTrim is a free, local toolkit that helps extend Claude Code usage limits by optimizing tool output and token spend. By using TokenTrim, developers can make their Claude Code limits last roughly 4x longer.

What you get

Free version available, Pro lifetime license for $49, Pro monthly subscription for $9

Why tokentrim

TokenTrim is designed for developers and CTOs at 10-200 person US software companies who hit Claude Code limits, providing a cost-effective solution to optimize token spend. With TokenTrim, users can track their token spend per session in a dashboard and make data-driven decisions to conserve tokens.

FAQ

Is TokenTrim affiliated with Anthropic? No, TokenTrim is not affiliated with Anthropic.

What is the benefit of using TokenTrim? TokenTrim helps extend Claude Code usage limits by optimizing tool output and token spend.

Next step: Download TokenTrim for free and start maximizing your Claude Code limits today
